prior_suggestions.start_name: Unnamed national-gas-grid tie-in point (not specified in any source found; the source only calls it a 'feed line' -- possibly a lateral off the Greater Cairo / Dahshur-area gas network given the sibling Dahshur-New Capital line's 70km route, but this is NOT confirmed for this specific 63km line)
prior_suggestions.end_name: New Administrative Capital Power Station (Siemens H-class combined-cycle plant, approx. 4,800 MW; located on the Cairo-Ain Sokhna road about 42 km from Qattamiya, New Administrative Capital, Cairo Governorate)
prior_suggestions.corridor_desc: Only the destination is well described in sources (New Administrative Capital power station, sited ~42km from Qattamiya along the Ain Sokhna road -- presidency.eg, live/verified), but I found no source naming the origin/tie-in point or the corridor the 63km line itself follows. Given the plant sits ~42-45km from central/southeast Cairo, a 63km feed line is geometrically consistent with a route from somewhere in the greater Cairo / Helwan / Dahshur gas-network corridor (the same general area the sibling 70km Dahshur-New Capital line starts from), but I cannot confirm this is the same corridor, a parallel corridor, or a shorter tap closer to 10th of Ramadan / Badr City. Do not treat this as more than a loose bound.

hint: PS = power station. New Administrative Capital power plant (Siemens megaproject) east of Cairo; sheet 63 km.
